name: North Haven Recreation Summer Day Camp
description_short: The town of North Haven's summer day camp for ages 3 to 13 at the Wakeley Community & Recreation Center, 8am to 5pm on weekdays. Each week has a theme with cooperative games, arts and crafts, a reading program and a special event, and ends with Pizza Day. Non-residents can join for $10 more a week.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds unless the department cancels the program, your place can be filled by another registration, or you provide a physician's note.
special_needs_notes: The Recreation Department welcomes participants with disabilities and makes reasonable accommodations under the ADA. Ask at registration, at least two weeks before the program starts.
